searchText: short call, i'm guessing people thought we had switched to a new schedule but last week was the off-week call i pulled out of devcon is there some takeaway notes? <trent_vanepps> > <trent_vanepps> any update on the server transition? would be great to have that by the end of the week! (re @CarlBeek: i should have a doc for review by EOD and we can start a deployment after feedback on that) <trent_vanepps> > <trent_vanepps> let me know when you have an implementation ready to share, we'll add it to the main repo https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony#client-implementations (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <Stefan Bratanov> [reply]: Agree the BLST docs are crap. 😄 As for the specs I find them good, they are very similar to the consensus-specs, so easy to follow. Hopefully I can release my implementation soon. 🙂 The signing and the API lifecycle is left.) - eth-org team will be shifting focus to the frontend next week to make sure we're ready for a lot of visitors, i18n, cleaning up copy, deployment strategy - doublesigning still needs to be finalized for the sequencer - Sigma Prime audit for sequencer and frontend starts Nov 7, **very important** to wrap as much as we can ahead of this so we don't send them half-finished repos
